why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Starling Marte is slot #5 (4.435 expected team runs/game).
Slots #5, #4, #6, #8, #7, #9, #3, #2, #1 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #6 ranks 3 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.002 R/G.
Slot #5 yields 4.23 expected PA/game vs 4.12 at primary slot #6. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
